name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer advancing its flagship Diablillos project in Salta province, Argentina. The project hosts a large-scale silver-gold deposit and is progressing toward a construction decision, having received approval under Argentina's RIGI large-scale investment regime. The company is in the development stage and is dual-listed on the TSX (ABRA) and OTCQX (ABBRF).
